items.title: Base change along an ideal on ind-etale algebras has a fully faithful right adjoint
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring A and an ideal I, the base change functor from ind-etale A-algebras to ind-etale A/I-algebras has a fully faithful right adjoint, so that every ind-etale A/I-algebra lifts to one over A (statement lines 1437-1450). The proof (proof lines 1452-1516) exhibits the lift as a filtered colimit over the directed category of factorizations through etale A-algebras, proves that the colimit reduces to the given algebra modulo the ideal, computes the Hom sets to get the adjunction, and reads off full faithfulness. H3: an original construction-and-computation argument with four inputs, written out in full.
